// --- GENERATED PROCEDURAL MODEL ---
// Noise Config: [Enabled: YES] [Resolution: 64x64]

void ModelSystem::BuildCustomModel() {
    auto addComponent = [&](glm::vec3 pos, glm::vec3 scale, glm::vec3 rot, glm::vec3 col) {
        // Use WorldGenerator::GenerateNoiseTexture(64, 64)
        this->CreateBox(pos, scale, rot, col);
    };

    // Base_Laton
    addComponent(
        glm::vec3(0.000f, -0.500f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.500f, 0.250f, 0.500f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.600f, 0.500f, 0.200f)
    );

    // Cuerpo_Rojo
    addComponent(
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.100f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.460f, 1.000f, 0.460f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.700f, 0.050f, 0.050f)
    );

    // Fulminante_Usado
    addComponent(
        glm::vec3(0.000f, -0.630f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.120f, 0.020f, 0.120f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.200f, 0.200f, 0.200f)
    );

    // Hollin_Superior
    addComponent(
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.600f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.480f, 0.050f, 0.480f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.050f, 0.050f, 0.050f)
    );

    // Interior_Oscuro
    addComponent(
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.550f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.400f, 0.100f, 0.400f),
        glm::vec3(0.000f, 0.000f, 0.000f),
        glm::vec3(0.500f, 0.500f, 0.500f)
    );

}
